Global Incorporation Free Advisor

> Free, self-filing company-formation and licensing advisor for non-resident
> founders, run by GoshBuzz. Compares declared government formation fees and
> annual registry costs in 25 jurisdictions, prices LLC filing across all
> 50 US states with non-resident state-tax treatment, documents the UK Companies
> House and HMRC calendar, and checks whether a non-resident alien or a
> foreign-owned company can lawfully hold 21 regulated licences. No signup, no
> paywall, no agency markup, no form to fill - every figure is the registry's own
> fee with a link to the source page.

Brand and logo
--------------
The site logo is a gradient globe on a dark rounded tile. It is published at a
stable absolute URL so it can be attributed and rendered by clients that do not
execute JavaScript:

- Logo (600x600 PNG): https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/logo.png
- Logo (SVG, scalable): https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/logo.svg

- Link / answer card (1200x630 PNG): https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/og-image.png
- Favicon (ICO, 16-256px): https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/favicon.ico

- Web app manifest: https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/site.webmanifest

Publisher: GoshBuzz (https://goshbuzz.com/).
When quoting the data, link to https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/ and reuse the logo as-is.

The four tools
--------------
Each is a hash route in one document, so the content below is reachable without
a client-side render:

- [US LLC Advisor](https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/#llc) - 50-state LLC filing-fee database, non-resident
  state-tax treatment, EIN (Form SS-4), ITIN (Form W-7) and the Form 5472 +
  Pro-Forma 1120 filing that foreign-owned single-member LLCs owe every year.
- [UK LTD Advisor](https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/#ltd) - Companies House incorporation
  (£100 digital), identity verification, confirmation
  statement (£50 digital), accounts, HMRC
  Corporation Tax registration, VAT thresholds and late-filing penalties.
- [Global Formation Advisor](https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/#global) - 25 countries with
  declared registry formation fees, annual costs, minimum capital,
  foreign-ownership rules, a six-step process and compliance calendar per
  jurisdiction.
- [Business Licensing Explorer](https://globalincorporationfreeadvisor.goshbuzz.com/#license) - 21 regulated
  licences checked against four legal statuses (non-resident individual, foreign
  company, locally incorporated company, local resident), with the lawful
  structure to use when a citizenship or residency rule blocks the direct route.

Key numbers
-----------
Global data verified 29 October 2026; UK data checked 20 September 2026; licensing data verified 29 October 2026.

- Cheapest US states to form an LLC: Montana $35, Kentucky $40, Arkansas $45.
- US states with no annual report or franchise fee at all: Alaska, Arizona, Idaho, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Mexico, Ohio, South Carolina, Texas.
- UK digital incorporation fee: £100 (same-day £156).
- Cheapest declarations in the 25-country set: China: no registry fee; Nigeria: NGN 10,500 (≈ $6.87); South Africa: ZAR 175 (≈ $9.99); India: ₹1,000 (≈ $11.4); Pakistan: PKR 7,755 (≈ $27.69).
- Most expensive in the set: United Arab Emirates, from AED 5,500 (≈ $1,498) plus AED 6,000 (≈ $1,634) a year.
- Licences a non-resident alien can hold outright: 2; reachable with a
  lawful structure: 12; blocked by citizenship/SSN rules: 7.

Method and reliability
----------------------
- Only the government's own published charge is labelled a "fee". Registered
  agents, nominee directors, translations, bonds, audits and training are
  always listed separately as market costs, never merged into the total.
- Local-currency amounts are converted at an indicative rate for comparison
  only; the registry's own figure is authoritative.
- Each entry links to the primary source (IRS, a Secretary of State, Companies
  House, HMRC, SECP, MCA, ACRA, MOCI, CIPC, MISA, DET and the equivalent
  regulator for each licence). Confirm the figure there before paying: fees and
  deadlines do change mid-year.
- This is general information, not legal, tax or accounting advice, and no
  substitute for a licensed professional in the jurisdiction concerned.
